rowDefs.label: Proposed budget, line level
rowDefs.why: The superintendent’s request. Establishes what was asked for.
rowDefs.howToGet: Published on the district’s budget page each winter, and mirrored here when it appears. Older years are in the meeting archive as School Committee packets.

rowDefs.label: Approved budget, line level
rowDefs.why: What the School Committee and Town Meeting settled on. The base every rate is measured from.
rowDefs.howToGet: The district’s approved budget document for that year. Where a year is missing it is usually because the document was posted to Google Drive and the link has since been walled.

rowDefs.label: Prior-year actuals, restated
rowDefs.why: A later budget document re-presenting the year. A restatement, not a ledger.
rowDefs.howToGet: Appears as an ACTUALS column inside a LATER year’s budget document, so it arrives one to three years after the year it describes. Nothing can make it arrive sooner.

rowDefs.label: Appropriation as voted
rowDefs.why: MUNIS original appropriation. What Town Meeting actually voted, before transfers.
rowDefs.howToGet: The ORIGINAL APPROP column of any MUNIS year-to-date budget report for that year, so it arrives with any of the quarterly reports below.

rowDefs.label: Q1 spend report (period 3)
rowDefs.why: First quarter. Needed for the seasonal baseline that makes a burn rate mean anything.
rowDefs.howToGet: MUNIS YEAR-TO-DATE BUDGET REPORT (program `glytdbud`), Fund 0100, Account type Expense, Year/Period YYYY/3, run with **Print totals only: N** and **Suppress zero bal accts: N**.

rowDefs.label: Q2 spend report (period 6)
rowDefs.howToGet: The same report at Year/Period YYYY/6.

rowDefs.label: Q3 spend report (period 9)
rowDefs.why: Three quarters. The last point at which a surplus could still be redirected.
rowDefs.howToGet: The same report at Year/Period YYYY/9. We hold FY26 at this period, but run as a department rollup rather than at account level.

rowDefs.label: Year-end position (period 12)
rowDefs.why: June, with the books not yet closed. Shows where a year landed; not what it finally turned back.
rowDefs.howToGet: The same `glytdbud` report at Year/Period YYYY/12. Held for FY26, sent by the Town Manager on 2 September 2026 in both printed and spreadsheet form — the first account-level expenditure report in this archive.

rowDefs.label: Year-end close (period 13)
rowDefs.why: After the lapse period. The surplus IS the available column on this report.
rowDefs.howToGet: The same report at Year/Period YYYY/13. This is the single most valuable missing document in the archive: without it no year’s surplus can be computed here at all.

rowDefs.label: Purchase orders closed after close
rowDefs.why: The step that moved FY25 from $582,115.44 to $603,885.97. Not recoverable from one report run.
rowDefs.howToGet: A list of purchase orders closed against the fiscal year after its initial close, with amounts and dates. Not a standard report — it has to be asked for in those words.

rowDefs.label: Revenue ledger
rowDefs.why: Chapter 70, local receipts, and transfers in. The expense side cannot see any of it.
rowDefs.howToGet: The same `glytdbud` report with Account type **Revenue**. Our FY26 copy was already run at account level, which is why this row is green where the expense rows beside it are not.

rowDefs.label: Revolving and grant fund activity
rowDefs.why: What the general fund line is net OF. Rule 11.
rowDefs.howToGet: `glytdbud` for the school grant, revolving and school choice funds — not Fund 0100. What we hold for FY26 is a fund-balance summary, one row per fund, which gives totals and not what they bought.

rowDefs.label: Grant awards listed
rowDefs.why: What was awarded. Not a mapping onto the lines a grant paid for — nobody publishes that.
rowDefs.howToGet: Listed inside the district’s own budget documents, so it arrives with them. The award is not the spending and never says which line it paid.

rowDefs.label: DESE all-funds per pupil, by function
rowDefs.why: An outside publisher’s view of the same spending, across every fund. Bounds the total the budget document cannot see.
rowDefs.howToGet: Public download, no request needed: doe.mass.edu/research/radar/district-comparison.xlsx. Note DESE counts costs the school budget does not carry, so it is a second opinion and not a like-for-like comparison.
